scene.prompt: Use case: compositing / product-mockup. Asset: NEW photoreal premium ecommerce lookbook still life, wide landscape composition approximately 8:5 (1600x1000). Input images 1-5 are product identity references (in order: speckled ivory Pulse Earbuds, black round Tide Watch, neatly folded grey jacquard Field Overshirt, matte black Arc Sunglasses, graphite Cell Power Bank). The setting is a warm sandy limestone terrace with a sculptural pale stone archway on the right, distant desert hills and a clear hazy blue sky fading to soft golden light near the horizon. Create an entirely fresh, professionally art-directed still life of exactly these five products on a warm limestone terrace at golden hour, faithfully matching their designs, fabrics, materials and colors. Modern luxury campaign photography with realistic natural light, small soft contact shadows, beautiful texture and excellent clarity. Composition: keep every product completely inside the frame with at least 6 percent margin. Place sunglasses at x15%, y77%; folded overshirt x34%, y66% as largest textile piece; watch upright x54%, y69%; earbuds case open x73%, y77%; power bank slightly leaning upright x88%, y72%. Arrange in a graceful loosely staggered row in the lower half, spaced apart, with usable sky/architecture above. No product overlapping another. Fresh frontal product angles from the supplied new references, no old steep floating diagonal shirt pose. The power bank MUST be fully visible including right edge. No UI markers, no buttons, no added text, no watermark. Keep natural golden warmth restrained rather than heavily orange. Products are the focus. Wide, refined, high fidelity photographic finish.
